name: Block Puzzle
gate: blockpuzzle_fair (NEW: simulate many seeded games with a greedy bot; the generator never deals a tray with zero placeable pieces while a placeable tray exists; daily seeds deterministic)
brief: Block Puzzle — 8x8 block-placement puzzle (score game: kind 'score', totalLevels 0; the genre leads 2026 downloads — never use the name "Block Blast" or copy its look). This folder was one of the blocked Dice Roller placeholder clones: replace EVERYTHING game-specific. Tray of 3 pieces; drag a piece with a lifted ghost preview offset above the finger; full rows/columns clear; combo/streak multipliers with big juicy clear effects; score + best; adaptive fair generator (never an impossible tray while a placeable one exists); game over when nothing fits -> one revive via rewarded ad (extra_life) that clears space / refreshes the tray; boosters Rotate, Bomb (3x3) and Refresh — main booster Bomb on field hintCount; daily challenge = seeded piece sequence with a target score. Tutorial: animated drag hand. Haptics on place and clear. Copy Puzzle2048's score-game pattern for gGame events.

name: Solitaire
gate: solitaire_winnable (NEW: re-deal every numbered deal from its seed and replay its stored solution to four full foundations)
brief: Solitaire (Klondike) — flagship classic (analogs: Microsoft Solitaire Collection, MobilityWare Solitaire). 500 numbered WINNABLE draw-1 deals verified by a solver, a daily deal, and Random Deal (draw-1 / draw-3). Deterministic seeded shuffle; store per deal its seed and a winning move list. UX: tap a card to move it to the best legal destination + drag and drop, smooth card animations, auto-complete when everything is face-up, free undo, Hint (best move highlighted), moves/score/timer, stars by moves, big readable cards in portrait (7 columns must fit 360 px), left-handed option, card-back and table themes, a cascading win celebration. Decide what lives mean (or keep them as energy for numbered deals) so every SKU and the Pass benefits are real. Main booster = Hint (field hintCount).

name: Sudoku
gate: sudoku_unique (NEW: every shipped puzzle has exactly one solution, equals the stored solution, and sits in its declared difficulty band)
brief: Sudoku — flagship classic Sudoku (analog: Sudoku.com by Easybrain). 500 puzzles with UNIQUE solutions in 4 bands (Easy 1-125, Medium 126-250, Hard 251-375, Expert 376-500) graded by a technique-based solver (naked/hidden singles -> pairs/triples -> pointing/claiming -> X-Wing/Swordfish...), plus a daily puzzle. UX: large readable 9x9 grid with bold 3x3 borders, number pad 1-9 with remaining counts, notes (pencil) mode, erase, undo, Hint (fills one correct cell and names the technique when possible), highlight row/column/box + same digits, conflict highlight, mistakes counter (3 mistakes = puzzle lost -> continue via rewarded ad or a life), timer, auto-clear notes on placement, small celebration when a row/column/box completes, stars by mistakes. Store puzzles compactly (81-char strings + solutions or solve at load). Main booster = Hint (field hintCount). Levels 1-3 very easy (>= 45 givens).

name: Flappy Wings
gate: flappywings_fair (NEW: course generator fairness — every gap passable at the speed/gravity used, difficulty ramp monotonic, daily seed deterministic)
brief: Flappy Wings — one-tap endless flyer (score game: GROWTH_CFG kind 'score', totalLevels 0). Art and trade dress must be ORIGINAL: no green pipes, no yellow-bird look-alike, and the words "Flappy Bird" must never appear anywhere (the folder was renamed for this reason; the Java package stays com.pegasusgames.flappybird and must not change). Concept suggestion: a little paper bird gliding through gates between floating cloud islands, warm sky palette. Canvas rendered at devicePixelRatio, 60 fps fixed-timestep physics, fair gap sizes, gentle difficulty ramp, feathers to collect mid-flight (+coins), medals (bronze >= 10, silver >= 25, gold >= 50, platinum >= 100), one revive per run via rewarded ad (type extra_life), skins = themes unlocked with coins, daily challenge = seeded course with a target, best score + gGame clear/gameover events (copy Puzzle2048's score-game pattern), haptics on flap/score, crisp sounds. Decide what lives mean here (the family top bar shows lives+coins; Puzzle2048 hides the heart — read how) and make every SKU meaningful. Main booster = Shield (absorbs one hit) on field hintCount. Tutorial: tap-to-flap overlay.

name: Sokoban
gate: sokoban_solvable (existing — keep it passing)
brief: Sokoban — classic warehouse box-pushing logic puzzle at premium quality: cozy, tactile, satisfying. Keep the 500 pull-generated, A*-verified levels of the current Sokoban (old game: git show 3c62c1ae~1:Sokoban/android/app/src/main/assets/game.html; generator Sokoban/test/gen_levels.py; gate scripts/check_sokoban_solvable.py must keep passing against your NEW game.html — read it to learn which array/format it parses and keep that format; only if unavoidable, add a NEW gate rather than editing the shared one, and report it). Gameplay: swipe + optional d-pad, smooth push animation, unlimited free undo, restart, move/push counters, stars by moves vs the optimal solution (compute optimal or near-optimal solutions offline with your solver and store them compactly), Hint = next move toward the stored solution from the current state (fall back to a bounded solver), deadlock warning (box stuck in a non-goal corner) with a gentle shake, level select grouped into themed chapters (e.g. 10 x 50), daily puzzle. 3-step tutorial.
